How much does it cost to run a heated throw?

A typical heated throw uses about 120 watts (60–160W depending on the model). Used for 3 hours per evening, 7 evenings a week, for 6 months of the year, it costs about 9.5p per evening and £17.24 a year at the current price cap rate.

Cost per evening
9.5p
About £17.24 a year at 3 hours per evening, 7 evenings a week, 6 months a year.

Standing charge not included.

About these figures

Ways to cut the cost

  • Heat the room you're in, with the door shut, rather than the whole house.
  • Use the thermostat and a timer rather than the highest setting.
  • Heating yourself (a blanket or heated throw) costs far less than heating the air.

Questions

How much does it cost to run a heated throw per hour?

At 26.32p/kWh, a 120W model costs about 3.2p an hour while it's running.

How much does it cost to run a heated throw per year?

About £17.24 a year, based on 3 hours per evening, 7 evenings a week, 6 months a year. Change the sliders above to match how you use yours.

Is the standing charge included?

No. You pay the standing charge every day whether or not the appliance is used, so it isn't part of the cost of running it.

How do I find my heated throw's actual power use?

Check the rating label, plug or manual for the wattage, or the energy label for kWh figures. A plug-in energy monitor shows exactly what it uses.
